cn_steps: 在 `编辑 > 插件` 里启用 `Ease Curve Tool` 并重启编辑器。
打开一个带动画轨道的 `Sequencer`，选中骨骼或 Transform 轨道上的若干关键帧。
打开曲线编辑器 `Curve Editor`，用 Ease Curve Tool 的预设库给选中关键帧套用缓入/缓出，例如 `Ease In Out`。
切换不同预设对比曲线形状，并手动拖动切线手柄做微调。
把满意的一套切线设置存成自定义预设，供同项目其它镜头复用。
回到 Sequencer 播放，确认关键帧之间不再是线性插值而是自然缓动。
en_steps: Enable `Ease Curve Tool` under `Edit > Plugins` and restart the editor.
Open a `Sequencer` with an animation track and select several keys on a bone or Transform track.
Open the `Curve Editor` and apply an ease-in/ease-out preset from the Ease Curve Tool library, e.g. `Ease In Out`, to the selected keys.
Toggle between presets to compare curve shapes, then drag the tangent handles to fine-tune.
Save the tuned tangent setup as a custom preset so other shots in the project can reuse it.
Play back in Sequencer and confirm keys now ease between poses instead of interpolating linearly.
note_cn: Ease Curve Tool 是曲线编辑器里的切线预设工具，只作用于选中的关键帧；预设可在项目内复用。
note_en: Ease Curve Tool is a tangent-preset helper inside Curve Editor that acts on selected keys only; presets are reusable across the project.

cn_steps: 启用 `Dataflow` 插件并重启；在内容浏览器右键新建 Dataflow 资产，或从几何集合的 Dataflow 入口进入。
在 Dataflow 编辑器节点面板拖入输入节点（几何 / Actor 输入），建立图的起点。
用 `DataflowNodes` 里的处理节点（采样、变换、生成）按「输入→处理→输出」连线成链。
选中输出节点点 `Evaluate`（或 Re-evaluate），在视口查看生成或变形结果。
把这张图绑定到目标资产，改参数后重新求值。
在编辑器预览确认运行时模块 `DataflowEnginePlugin` 也能重算结果。
en_steps: Enable the `Dataflow` plugin and restart; right-click in the Content Browser to create a Dataflow asset, or enter from a Geometry Collection's Dataflow entry.
In the Dataflow editor, drag an input node (geometry / Actor input) from the palette to seed the graph.
Wire `DataflowNodes` processing nodes (sample, transform, generate) into an input → process → output chain.
Select the output node and click `Evaluate` (or Re-evaluate) to see the generated or deformed result in the viewport.
Bind the graph to the target asset and re-evaluate after changing parameters.
Preview in the editor to confirm the runtime module `DataflowEnginePlugin` recomputes the result too.
note_cn: `DataflowEditor` 只在编辑器侧；运行时重算由 `DataflowEnginePlugin` 与 `DataflowNodes` 承担，别把编辑器模块加进 Game Target。
note_en: `DataflowEditor` is editor-only; runtime recompute comes from `DataflowEnginePlugin` and `DataflowNodes` — never put the editor module in a Game target.

cn_steps: 启用 `Editor Performance` 插件并重启（Experimental，先在测试项目里用）。
复现卡顿操作（大关卡 PIE、全量编译、自动保存），让插件记录编辑器 stall。
通过 `StallLogSubsystem` 的日志/控制台命令查看 stall 记录，检查 stall 时长与调用栈。
若触发崩溃，读取 `CrashDiagnostics` 生成的诊断信息定位崩溃上下文。
对照热点优化（关掉重型视口实时预览、拆关卡、削减编辑器 tick 负担）。
复跑同样操作，比较前后 stall 次数确认改善。
en_steps: Enable `Editor Performance` and restart (Experimental — try it in a test project first).
Reproduce the hitch (large-map PIE, full compile, autosave) so the plugin records editor stalls.
Inspect stall records via `StallLogSubsystem` logs/console commands, checking stall duration and call stacks.
If it crashes, read the `CrashDiagnostics` output to locate the crash context.
Optimize the hot spots (disable heavy real-time viewport preview, split levels, trim editor tick load).
Re-run the same operations and compare stall counts before/after to confirm the win.
note_cn: 该插件把编辑器性能反馈给开发者，靠 `StallLogSubsystem` 记录卡顿、`CrashDiagnostics` 记录崩溃；Experimental 接口可能变。
note_en: It feeds editor performance back to developers via `StallLogSubsystem` for stalls and `CrashDiagnostics` for crashes; Experimental, so the API may change.

cn_steps: 启用 `Editor Scripting Utilities` 插件并重启。
新建一个 Editor Utility Blueprint，在事件图里右键搜索 `Editor Asset Library`、`Editor Level Library` 节点。
用 `Get All Assets`、`Rename Asset`、`Set Metadata Tag` 编写批量资产整理逻辑。
用 `Editor Level Library` 批量选中或替换当前关卡里的 Actor。
也可在 Output Log 切到 Python，`import unreal` 后调用 `unreal.EditorAssetLibrary` 做同样脚本化操作。
把脚本做成 Editor Utility Widget 按钮，让团队一键执行。
en_steps: Enable `Editor Scripting Utilities` and restart.
Create an Editor Utility Blueprint and, in the event graph, right-click to search nodes like `Editor Asset Library` and `Editor Level Library`.
Use `Get All Assets`, `Rename Asset`, and `Set Metadata Tag` to script bulk asset cleanup.
Use `Editor Level Library` to select or replace Actors in the current level in bulk.
Alternatively, switch Output Log to Python, `import unreal`, and call `unreal.EditorAssetLibrary` for the same scripting tasks.
Wrap the script in an Editor Utility Widget button so the team can run it in one click.
note_cn: 它是编辑器脚本库（蓝图 / Python 的 EditorAssetLibrary、EditorLevelLibrary 等），只用于编辑器自动化，不要作为游戏运行时依赖。
note_en: It is an editor scripting library (Blueprint / Python `EditorAssetLibrary`, `EditorLevelLibrary`, etc.) for editor automation only — not a game runtime dependency.

cn_steps: 启用 `Editor System Configuration Assistant` 并重启。
在 `Window` / `Tools` 菜单打开该助手面板。
让它扫描当前机器与项目配置，读取给出的配置建议列表。
按建议逐项调整项目设置（渲染特性、DDC、内存相关选项等）。
重启编辑器后复核面板，确认建议项不再报警。
en_steps: Enable `Editor System Configuration Assistant` and restart.
Open its panel from the `Window` / `Tools` menu.
Let it scan the current machine and project settings and read the suggestion list it returns.
Apply the suggestions one by one in Project Settings (render features, DDC, memory-related options, etc.).
Restart and re-check the panel to confirm the flagged items are cleared.
note_cn: 该助手只提供系统配置建议，需要按提示逐项改用；属于编辑器侧工具。
note_en: The assistant only offers system-configuration suggestions you apply by hand; it is an editor-side utility.

cn_steps: 启用 `Editor Telemetry`（`RuntimeTelemetry` 模块）并重启。
在项目遥测设置里配置上报端点与开关。
正常操作编辑器，触发常见事件（启动、退出、崩溃、功能使用）。
在遥测后端或本地日志核对事件是否经由 `RuntimeTelemetry` 上报。
按团队隐私策略裁剪要上报的事件类别。
en_steps: Enable `Editor Telemetry` (the `RuntimeTelemetry` module) and restart.
Configure the reporting endpoint and toggles in the project telemetry settings.
Use the editor normally to trigger common events (startup, shutdown, crash, feature usage).
Verify in the telemetry backend or local logs that events are emitted through `RuntimeTelemetry`.
Prune event categories per your team's privacy policy.
note_cn: 这份条目对应 `RuntimeTelemetry` 模块版本（运行时模块），Experimental，正式项目接入前先确认合规。
note_en: This entry maps to the `RuntimeTelemetry` module variant; Experimental — confirm compliance before adopting in shipping projects.

cn_steps: 启用 `Editor Telemetry`（`EditorTelemetry` 模块）并重启。
确认它只在编辑器进程里发出遥测，不进入游戏运行时。
操作编辑器触发事件，检查本地日志或后端确定上报内容。
按需在遥测设置里开关具体事件，避免收集敏感信息。
en_steps: Enable `Editor Telemetry` (the `EditorTelemetry` module) and restart.
Confirm it emits telemetry only in the editor process and stays out of the game runtime.
Drive editor actions to trigger events, then check local logs or the backend for what is reported.
Toggle specific events in telemetry settings as needed to avoid collecting sensitive data.
note_cn: 这份条目是 `EditorTelemetry` 编辑器模块版本，与 `RuntimeTelemetry` 同名不同模块；Experimental。
note_en: This entry is the `EditorTelemetry` editor-module variant — same display name as, but a different module from, `RuntimeTelemetry`; Experimental.

cn_steps: 启用 `Editor Tests` 插件并重启。
打开 `Tools > Session Frontend`（或 `Window > Developer Tools > Session Frontend`）的 Automation 标签。
勾选 `Editor` 相关测试集，点 `Start Tests`。
查看结果面板，定位失败用例并对照日志排查。
CI 场景改用命令行：`UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe YourProject.uproject -ExecCmds="Automation RunTests Editor; Quit"`。
en_steps: Enable `Editor Tests` and restart.
Open the Automation tab in `Tools > Session Frontend` (or `Window > Developer Tools > Session Frontend`).
Tick the `Editor` test set and click `Start Tests`.
Review the results panel, locate failing cases, and inspect the logs.
For CI, run the command line instead: `UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe YourProject.uproject -ExecCmds="Automation RunTests Editor; Quit"`.
note_cn: 这是自动化测试插件，价值在于跑 `Editor` 测试集并看报告，而不是拖进关卡；在 Session Frontend / 命令行里执行。
note_en: It is an automation-testing plugin — its value is running the `Editor` test set and reading the report, not dragging into a level; execute via Session Frontend or the command line.

cn_steps: 启用 `EditorDataStorageToolset` 并重启（Experimental）。
确认编辑器正在使用数据存储 (TEDS)，例如大纲视图背后的实体/行数据。
让编辑器 AI 助手通过工具集注册表调用该工具集的查询接口。
读取返回的实体与列数据，做只读检查（有哪些实体、每个实体有哪些字段）。
需要改动时改走其它写入路径，避免直接篡改 TEDS。
en_steps: Enable `EditorDataStorageToolset` and restart (Experimental).
Confirm the editor is using the Data Storage (TEDS), e.g. the entity/row data behind the Outliner.
Have the in-editor AI assistant call this toolset's query API through the Toolset Registry.
Read the returned entities and columns for read-only inspection (which entities exist and which fields each has).
Route any changes through other write paths instead of mutating TEDS directly.
note_cn: 这是给编辑器 AI 助手用的只读/查询工具集，用来检查运行时 TEDS；Experimental，不进 Shipping 游戏。
note_en: A read/query toolset for the in-editor AI assistant to inspect TEDS at runtime; Experimental and not a shipping game feature.

cn_steps: 启用 `EditorDebugTools` 并重启。
在 `Window > Developer Tools` 里找到它注册的调试面板或命令。
用面板检查目标对象的运行时状态，配合 Output Log 关键字过滤。
定位问题后关闭面板，避免长期开启拖慢编辑器。
en_steps: Enable `EditorDebugTools` and restart.
Find the debug panel or commands it registers under `Window > Developer Tools`.
Inspect target-object runtime state with the panel and filter Output Log by keyword.
Close the panel once the issue is located so it does not slow the editor.
note_cn: 编辑器调试工具（无官方描述），主要服务于制作期排错，别加进游戏运行时。
note_en: An editor debug tool (no official description) for authoring-time troubleshooting; keep it out of the game runtime.

cn_steps: 启用 `EditorToolset` 并重启（Experimental）。
确保 AI Toolset Registry 可用且编辑器 AI 助手已连上。
通过该工具集让助手操作核心类型：列出/创建蓝图、读取或设置 Actor 与属性。
在 AI 助手里下自然语言指令，观察它对蓝图/Actor/属性的实际读写结果。
验证结果无误后再让助手做批量改动。
en_steps: Enable `EditorToolset` and restart (Experimental).
Make sure the AI Toolset Registry is available and the in-editor AI assistant is connected.
Use this toolset to have the assistant act on core types: list/create Blueprints, read or set Actors and properties.
Issue natural-language instructions in the AI assistant and watch the actual read/write results on Blueprints/Actors/properties.
Once results are correct, let the assistant perform bulk changes.
note_cn: 这是通过 AI 工具集注册表操作编辑器核心类型（蓝图、Actor、属性）的工具集；Experimental，仅供编辑器 AI 助手/自动化。
note_en: A toolset that drives core editor types (Blueprints, Actors, properties) through the AI Toolset Registry; Experimental and for the in-editor AI assistant/automation only.

cn_steps: 启用 `Electra Codecs` 并重启。
在项目设置对应平台的 Media 里把 Electra 设为默认播放器并选定解码器。
新建 Media Player 与 Media Source（文件或流），`Open` 视频。
把 Media Texture 贴到材质或 Media Plate 预览，确认 `ElectraDecoders` 解码出画。
播放时检查所选解码格式，必要时切换解码器。
en_steps: Enable `Electra Codecs` and restart.
In the platform Media settings, set Electra as the default player and pick a decoder.
Create a Media Player and Media Source (file or stream) and `Open` the video.
Put the Media Texture on a material or Media Plate to preview and confirm `ElectraDecoders` decodes and renders.
While playing, check the chosen decode format and switch decoders if needed.
note_cn: 它是 Electra 的解码器插件（`ElectraDecoders` / `ElectraCodecFactory`），决定能播哪些编码；支持集合以解码器模块为准。
note_en: It is Electra's decoder plugin (`ElectraDecoders` / `ElectraCodecFactory`) that decides which codecs play; the supported set follows the decoder modules.

cn_steps: 启用 `ElectraCDM` 并重启。
在项目设置为 Electra 配置 DRM（如 Widevine/PlayReady）及许可证服务器地址。
打开受保护的 Media Source，通过 Electra 播放触发许可证请求。
由 `ElectraCDM` 处理许可证与解密。
通过 Media Player 回调确认解密成功后正常出画。
en_steps: Enable `ElectraCDM` and restart.
In Project Settings, configure DRM for Electra (e.g. Widevine/PlayReady) and the license server URL.
Open the protected Media Source and play through Electra to trigger license acquisition.
Let `ElectraCDM` handle the license and decryption.
Confirm via Media Player callbacks that decryption succeeds and video renders.
note_cn: 内容解密模块，只负责 DRM/许可证解密；需要有效许可证服务器与密钥配置才能出画。
note_en: The content decryption module handles DRM/license decryption only; you need a valid license server and keys for video to render.

cn_steps: 启用 `ElectraSubtitles` 并重启。
打开带字幕轨（如 WebVTT/TTML）的流或文件 Media Source。
在 Media Player 里选择字幕轨，让 `ElectraSubtitles` 解码字幕样本。
把字幕文本接到 UI（如 Text Block）或用回调按时码渲染。
播放中切换字幕轨验证同步。
en_steps: Enable `ElectraSubtitles` and restart.
Open a stream or file Media Source that carries a subtitle track (e.g. WebVTT/TTML).
Select the subtitle track in the Media Player so `ElectraSubtitles` decodes the caption samples.
Feed the caption text to UI (e.g. a Text Block) or render via callbacks by timecode.
Switch subtitle tracks during playback to verify sync.
note_cn: 字幕解码模块，负责解出字幕样本；渲染与 UI 需要你自己接。
note_en: A subtitle decoder module that yields caption samples; rendering and UI wiring are up to you.

cn_steps: 启用 `ElectraUtil` 并重启。
了解它提供的基础组件：`ElectraBase`、`ElectraSamples`、`ElectraHTTPStream`。
做自定义媒体集成时，链接这些模块处理样本与通过 HTTP 拉流。
把拉到的流/样本送入 Electra 播放管线，配合 Media Player 预览。
确认常规 Electra 播放无需额外操作——这些基础组件会被自动复用。
en_steps: Enable `ElectraUtil` and restart.
Note the base components it provides: `ElectraBase`, `ElectraSamples`, `ElectraHTTPStream`.
For custom media integration, link these modules to process samples and pull streams over HTTP.
Feed the fetched stream/samples into the Electra playback pipeline and preview with a Media Player.
Confirm plain Electra playback needs no extra work — these base components are reused automatically.
note_cn: 这是 Electra 的可复用基础组件（基础类型、样本、HTTP 流），多见于自定义解封装/拉流集成，一般随播放器自动使用。
note_en: Reusable Electra base components (base types, samples, HTTP streaming) mostly used in custom demux/streaming integration; normally reused automatically by the player.
